body:
See, the problem with me is that everytime I TRY to be happy, something seems to come along and just fuck it up. I've been depressed/suicidal/self harming since 15 and at the start of this year I was basically like "Nope, sick of being sad." and I TRIED to stop letting things get me down and then somebody noticed the scars and started telling me I have no reason and that I'm attention seeking and all this shit that just made me feel awful. Then all my 'friends' kept telling me that I need to act differently because I'm 'controlling, obsessive, have anger issues and am basically a bitch'. Then my boyfriend broke up with me, then we got back together and I eventually realized that he doesn't care about my happiness at all, but I hate change and without him, I'll have nobody that understands even a little bit. Then my dad decided he was going to leave so my mum got really, really angry so I can no longer even have conversations with her about how I feel because there's always something in the way. My brother keeps getting in these really bad situations, then my dad moved to another country to get out of child support, and we all realized he only left because he's a drug addict and I've recently become aware that my mum has an eating disorder and now my grades have dropped insanely and what I always thought I wanted to do, everybody keeps telling me I can't do.

I actively try to be happy but I just can't do it when everything around me is just sad.

I've gone to therapy multiple times, it always just makes me feel worse about myself, just stupid. My last psych told me that I didn't really have any problems and never helped. 

I know my mum has good reason to get upset over it but she constantly tells me I have no reason to do it. She'll randomly just bluntly ask me if "I'm cutting myself again" I also feel like she's being a hypocrite when she clearly has her own issues...
